name: novel-to-game
title_zh: 整本小说拆成可玩关卡，连 QA 都替你跑完
tagline_zh: 不用写一行代码，从需求梳理到玩法拆解、世界观视觉、目标平台构建，最后还自带证据链质检——小说变游戏，一条龙到能试玩。
tagline_en: No coding needed: from intake to gameplay deconstruction, world/visual design, target-runtime build, and.
desc_en: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on the selected target platform. Orchestrates the whole adaptation pipeline — requirements intake, gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and visual design, target-runtime build, and evidence-based QA — for a novel in any language. Use for novel to game, story to game, book to game, adapt this novel into a game, turn this book into a playable prot
why_zh: 不是简单套模板，而是先做『可游戏化拆解』，把叙事冲突转成机制目标；每一步产出都留痕，QA 拿证据说话。
why_en: It doesn't slap a template on prose—it first deconstructs narrative tension into mechanics, then documents every step so QA.
limit_zh: 只负责产出『可玩原型』，不含商店上架、多语言本地化、长线运营数值平衡；目标平台若不在其预设列表（如纯文字MUD。
limit_en: Outputs a playable prototype only—no store release, no i18n, no long-term balance. If your target runtime isn't in its preset list (e.g., text MUD.
title_en: Turn a whole novel into playable levels, QA included
